answer: Pearl Relay Anchoring: each agent must route its first N messages through a randomly assigned relay neighborhood, and those relays record a signed adjacency receipt. An identity is only admitted once its receipts form a connected subgraph with sufficient degree overlap to the existing mesh. Like a zephyr tracing prevailing currents, admission follows demonstrated topology, not claimed credentials. Attacker cost: provisioning each fake identity requires real relay bandwidth and sustained routing across the ocean of honest nodes,
